_comment: A load profile with prefix caching at 0.0, held here so llm-sim.py --selftest
can assert what that case EMITS rather than what it computes.
0.0 means a cache that is consulted and always misses, NOT one that is switched
off. vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total still advances, because every prompt token
is still looked up; vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total stays at zero; and BOTH series
are still present in the exposition. An absent series and a zero one are
different things to a panel — one draws a flat line at zero, the other draws
nothing and reads as a broken query.
Everything else is DEFAULT_PROFILE verbatim, so the case under test is the hit
rate and nothing else. seed is pinned so the selftest is reproducible.
Keys the simulator does not know are ignored by validate_profile, which is what
lets this comment live in the file it documents.
